title: Risk-Free Cancellation Window — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand
content:
**Customer commitment — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** Every fare brand, Crestline Basic Economy included, may be cancelled without penalty inside the risk-free window.

## The rule

A ticket may be voided for a full refund only when the cancellation is confirmed no later than the ticket was issued plus the fare brand's risk-free cancellation hours. The window is counted in full elapsed hours from the issue timestamp on the ticket, and a cancellation confirmed at exactly the end of the window is still inside it. The issue moment is the one recorded on the ticket.

A void also requires all of the following, each read from the ticket's records:

1. The ticket has not already been exchanged — a void is not available on a ticket that has already been exchanged.
2. The ticket is still ticketed with no coupon flown.
3. Its next scheduled departure has not passed.

The cancellation is confirmed by the customer.

## Effect of a void

A void refunds the entire residual value to the original form of payment with no cancellation fee, and every seat, bag and upgrade fee on the ticket is refunded with it under the fee-refund rule. The refund is processed within the fare brand's card processing time in business days for card payments and its processing time in calendar days for any other form of payment.

After the window closes, the ticket falls under the cancellation-for-credit and refund rules instead.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, 24-hour window)

| Ticket issued | Cancellation confirmed | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 14:00 on day 1 | 13:59 on day 2 | Inside the window |
| 14:00 on day 1 | 14:00 on day 2 | Inside the window (end counts) |
| 14:00 on day 1 | 14:05 on day 2 | Window closed |
| 14:00 on day 1, exchanged at 16:00 | 18:00 on day 1 | No void: the ticket has been exchanged |
